description: Upload an image snapshot of a 3D Image Studio scene. Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP bytes; upstream stores it as an intermediate system file. Cookie/web-session auth is the reliable auth mode for this legacy route.
name: artcraft_upload_studio_scene_snapshot

file_path.description: Local image file to upload as the scene snapshot

scene_media_token.description: Optional engine scene media token to link
